summary: The Localization module provides functionality for translating UI elements based on alternative language settings. It includes functions to translate field text, file types, and date/time strings depending on the locale.
purpose: This module facilitates the localization of user interface elements by translating field labels and strings into alternate languages, accommodating users who require language-specific content.

fields.name: UseAltLanguageFields
fields.description: Determines whether alternative language fields are used.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Array of UI controls to be translated.

fields.name: newValues
fields.description: Array of new translated values for the controls.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Represents a user session, including language settings.

workflows.name: Translate Fields
steps: Check if alternative language fields should be used.
Iterate through each field to be translated.
Update the field's text to its corresponding translated value if applicable.

workflows.name: Translate File Type
steps: Check session for alternative language usage.
Return the appropriate file type string based on the language setting.

workflows.name: Translate Last Login
steps: Check session for alternative language usage.
Replace English month abbreviations with their alternative language equivalent in the LastLogin string.

system_behavior: Updates field text and returns language-appropriate file types and date strings.
Ensures that localization can be applied dynamically at runtime based on settings.
